evidence: Across 366 held-out publication days, the inventory-value policy captured 308 seven-day identity reverts, versus 287 with a fixed threshold and 1095 for an outcome-aware upper bound.
next_decision: Use logged arrivals to price the next slot. Compare operational rules with both ceilings; knowing the best future scores and knowing the future outcomes are different advantages.
boundary: An identity revert indicates that previously observed page content returned within seven days. It is a behavioral proxy. The replay assumes no effect of the simulated review on subsequent edits.
